name: moatmap-data
title: MoatMap open data: decile tracker and monthly Best Stocks lists
description: Out-of-sample decile returns for MoatMap's Quality, Value and Momentum ranking, and the monthly top-25 lists by country. Research data, not investment advice.

fields.name: regime_id
fields.description: Scoring version the vintage was formed under

fields.name: vintage_date
fields.description: Day the deciles were formed

fields.name: decile
fields.description: 1 = highest scores, 10 = lowest

fields.name: rank_field
fields.description: Score the deciles were formed on: stockrank, quality_rank, value_rank, momentum_rank, qv, qm, vm

fields.name: scope
fields.description: investable (market cap >= $200M and >= $1M a day traded at formation) or full

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: End of the return window (the next vintage)

fields.name: period_days
fields.description: Length of the window in days

fields.name: n_formed
fields.description: Companies in the decile at formation

fields.name: n_stocks
fields.description: Companies with a price at period_end

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: n_stocks / n_formed

fields.name: n_price_fallback
fields.description: Companies priced from stored daily prices
